integrated_description: Alex must immediately stop using Jordan's rollerblades before any conversation takes place, then promptly initiate an honest confession using plain, direct language that fully discloses the duration, frequency, and current condition of the skates — acknowledging the autonomy violation, not merely potential wear. Alex must offer concrete, immediate compensation for wear and tear (repair or replacement costs) as a good-faith act, and only if Jordan consents may a strictly time-limited, condition-checked, explicitly defined temporary borrowing arrangement be established while Alex saves up for their own pair.
integration_rationale: All three stakeholders converged on the same four operational requirements — immediate cessation, honest full disclosure, tangible upfront compensation, and tightly governed conditional borrowing — allowing complete integration without any trade-offs or omissions. The core synthesis direction of confess-apologize-save-independently is preserved and strengthened by making each step concrete, time-bound, and consent-governed.
